text.p: Committee on Research, Technological Development and Energy [[ Tuesday 10 June 1997 ]] EXTRAORDINARY MEETING ===] Tuesday, 10 June 1997, 5.30 pm 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 222.466 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 2. Statement by Commissioner Christos PAPOUTSIS on the outcome of the Energy Council of 27 May 1997 - Exchange of views 3. Draft supplementary and amending budget no 1/97 (T05478) (T05478) BUD0089 SEC(97)0750 C4-0195/97 + ENER Avis McNALLY Eryl M. (PSE) (PE222.549 ) F BUDG Fond R BRINKHORST Laurens J (ELD) (PE222.050 ) - First consideration of draft opinion - Deadline for tabling amendments 4. Chairman's announcements 5. Any other business 6. Date of next meeting - Wednesday, 18 June 1997, from 3-6.30 pm, and Thursday, 19 June 1997 from 9 am - 12.30 p.m.: BRUSSELS ===] Coordinators' meeting (to be confirmed) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
